prompt: Long 85mm lens across a roulette table in a burgundy lounge, the wheel a blurred gold arc along the very bottom of the frame, well below the chin. One low green-shaded lamp overhead pools light on two men. The singer, three-quarter to us and sharp, fills a third of the frame height with his mouth open mid-word, the lamp full on his lips. Just behind his shoulder and smaller, a Black upright bass player of about 60, tall and white-haired, leans on the instrument's neck, mouth closed. Far back through a doorway, a small hand-press burns orange, loose blank sheets curling. Green and orange against shadow. No lettering, no black bars. Thanks.
